errors.disabled: the token optimizer is off for this run
errors.no_worker: the agent's worker engine has no usable default LLM profile in this workspace
errors.provider_unsupported: the default LLM profile of the worker's engine uses a provider the token optimizer cannot call yet (only anthropic, openai and openai-compatible)
errors.profile_not_usable: the default LLM profile of the worker's engine cannot back a worker: it has no key, or holds a credential the daemon may not send to the provider's API that is not a Claude Code subscription token either (a federated profile, a Claude subscription token on another engine's profile); give that engine a default profile with an API key or a Claude Code token
errors.timeout: the token optimizer worker did not answer in time
errors.upstream_unreachable: the worker's provider could not be reached
errors.upstream_response: the worker's provider sent a response that could not be read
errors.empty_answer: the worker's provider sent an empty answer
errors.unfinished: the run's pod never reported how this delegation ended
errors.files_required: a read needs at least one file
errors.too_many_files: a read may send at most {max} files
errors.invalid_level: the level must be off, suggest or enforce, not {level:%q}
errors.worker_in_pod: this worker runs in the run's own pod through the Claude Code CLI, with the worker profile's subscription token; prepare it with /internal/token-optimizer/prepare instead of asking the daemon to call it
errors.worker_not_in_pod: this worker is called by the daemon through the provider's API; delegate to it with /internal/token-optimizer/delegate instead of running it in the pod
errors.invalid_status: status must be ok, failed or timeout, not {status:%q}
errors.invalid_error_code: error_code must be empty or a tokenopt.errors key, at most {max} characters
errors.write_removed: the token optimizer does not delegate writes: write the file yourself
errors.engine_required: the token optimizer needs the worker's engine when it is on
errors.unknown_engine: the token optimizer's engine {engine:%q} is not a registered engine
errors.model_required: the token optimizer needs the worker's model when it is on

prompts.bulk_reader:
You are a precise code analyst. You read the files you are given and answer the question that follows them, for another engineer who will act on your answer without reading the files.

Rules:
- Answer in structured bullets only. No introduction, no summary, no closing remarks.
- Lead every bullet with the exact name, type and line it is about, as they appear in the file (for example `parseConfig (func, config.go:42)`).
- Quote identifiers, signatures, constants and error messages exactly. Never paraphrase code you are citing.
- Answer only what was asked. Skip files, symbols and details the question does not need.
- If the files do not contain the answer, say so in one bullet and name what is missing. Never guess.
